WHO WE ARE

Changed from the inside out

At the heart of our calling is a simple conviction: God still changes lives.

Deeper Life Bible Church (DLBC), Lewisville, Texas, is a local congregation of Deeper Christian Life Ministry (DCLM). We exist for one clear purpose: to help people know God deeply, live in biblical holiness, and walk in His purpose—so their lives are transformed here on earth and prepared for eternity with Christ.

We are a Bible-centered Christian church and community committed to the message of holiness unto the Lord: not outward religion or “feel-good” Christianity, but a life that is genuinely changed from the inside out—where true faith in Jesus Christ shapes how we think, live, speak, work, act, and relate to others in everyday life.

At the heart of our calling is a simple conviction: God still changes lives.

Through the preaching of the Gospel, prayer, and obedience to Scripture, we have seen broken lives restored, families strengthened, and individuals redirected toward lasting hope and purpose.

Our foundation is the Word of God. We believe the Bible is clear, sufficient, and relevant to every culture and generation. It speaks into personal struggles, family life, moral decisions, and the deeper questions of meaning that people everywhere face today.

Our emphasis on holiness is not legalism—it is a response to God’s love. It is the call to live differently and please God daily in a world filled with confusion, compromise, and pressure. We believe holiness leads to clarity, peace, integrity, and strength in daily life, while also preparing the believer for eternity.

We prioritize inner transformation over external rules. We value a modest, respectful environment that allows everyone to focus completely on the presence of God without distractions.

WHY WE EXIST

Grace that transforms, truth that clarifies

We exist to bring people into a living relationship with Jesus Christ, where grace transforms character and truth clarifies direction.

To help people experience salvation and new life in Christ
To teach practical, Bible-based Christian living
To build strong families and communities rooted in truth and integrity
To prepare believers for faithful living on earth and eternal life in heaven

We believe the Gospel is both about how we live right now and about where we go after death.

OUR MESSAGE AND HERITAGE

Shaped by Scripture since 1973

Deeper Christian Life Ministry (DCLM) has been shaped by a consistent focus on Scripture and personal holiness under the leadership of Pastor W.F. Kumuyi, who founded it in 1973.

Pastor Kumuyi is a global voice for biblical holiness and a widely read author. Through the Global Crusade with Kumuyi (GCK), he continues to reach millions, empowering them to live a life of spiritual power and integrity.

His ministry has been characterized by a simple, direct, and Bible-saturated teaching style that has helped many people encounter the relevance of God’s Word in practical life.

Pastor Kumuyi’s preaching is marked by clarity, depth, and careful attention to Scripture, making the Bible accessible across every level of society—from everyday workers to professionals. This emphasis has helped shape a global community centered on the authority of God’s Word and the pursuit of a transformed life.

1973
DCLM founded as a Bible study of 15 students at the University of Lagos

14
States in our Southwest Region, under Pastor Thompson Aderemi

OUR VISION

The church we’re committed to being

We are committed to being a church that is:

Biblically grounded in a shifting cultural landscape
Spiritually alive, not merely religious in form
Strong in truth, love, and moral clarity
Active in serving communities with compassion and integrity

We believe the same Gospel that changes lives anywhere in the world is fully relevant to life in the United States today—addressing anxiety, identity, brokenness, success, failure, and the search for meaning.

A Life That Thrives Now and Forever

Our goal is simple: that people would not only believe in Christ but walk with Him daily in a way that brings real transformation now and, one day, an eternal reign with Christ in heaven.

A life aligned with God brings stability in uncertainty, purpose in confusion, and hope in difficulty. And beyond this life, it leads to eternal life with Him.

This is the heart of Deeper Life Bible Church Lewisville, Texas: to live holy unto the Lord, to walk in godliness, and to help others do the same—so we can thrive both in this life on earth and in eternity with God in heaven.

LEADERSHIP

The people who shepherd us

GENERAL SUPERINTENDENT

Pastor (Dr.) W.F. Kumuyi

Founder and General Superintendent of Deeper Life Bible Church Worldwide

Pastor (Dr.) W.F. Kumuyi founded Deeper Christian Life Ministry in 1973 as a Bible study of 15 students at the University of Lagos, where he lectured in mathematics. He has led the ministry as General Superintendent ever since, and it now has congregations around the world. His preaching is known for its clarity, its depth in Scripture, and its call to holy living.

Read full bio
of Pastor (Dr.) W.F. Kumuyi

REGIONAL OVERSEER

Pastor Thompson Aderemi

Overseer of the Southwest region comprising of 14 states

Pastor Thompson Aderemi is a missionary, church planter, and seasoned servant of God whose life has been wholly committed to rescuing the perishing and advancing the gospel.

Read full bio
of Pastor Thompson Aderemi

LOCAL PASTOR

Pastor Joseph Agbo

Local Pastor of Deeper Life Bible Church, Lewisville Texas

Pastor Joseph Agbo grew up in a deeply religious home as the son of a minister in an orthodox church. However, he was not born again until 1988, when he surrendered his life to Christ during his university years.
